rows.jp: 「しかし、なんもわからんわけだ」
rows.en: “So we’re back to knowing nothing.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Anyway, we don't get this at all and that's that."

rows.jp: 「あの子が頑張れば、謎そのものは解けると思う」
rows.en: “I think that girl can solve the mystery if she keeps at it.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "If that girl does her best, she can untangle all of this enigma I think."

rows.jp: 「彼女？　曜子ちゃんかな？」
rows.en: “That girl? You mean Youko?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Her? Youko-chan you mean?"

rows.jp: 「……好きにはなれないけどね」
rows.en: “...I’ll never like her, though.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "...but getting to like her is out of the question."

rows.jp: と唇を尖らせる。
rows.en: She pouted.

ghs.en: With lips on edge, looking displeased.

rows.jp: 「嫌いなんだ」
rows.en: “You hate her?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You hate her."

rows.jp: 「そうじゃないけど……なんとなく気にくわない」
rows.en: “Not exactly... She just rubs me the wrong way.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "I don't but... it's that somehow I can't stand her."

rows.jp: 「ふーん」
rows.en: “Hmm.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hummm."

rows.jp: 「掃除させたあとで窓枠を指で撫でて、不備を指摘してやる」
rows.en: “I’ll make her clean, then run a finger along the window frame and tell her everything she missed.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "I'd make her to do cleaning, then I would brush just one finger on the windowsill to point out her inadequacy."

rows.jp: 「姑みたいな思考だな」
rows.en: “You think like somebody’s mother-in-law.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You're thinking like a mother-in-law."

rows.jp: 「姑かぁ……悪くないよねぇ」
rows.en: “Mother-in-law... I could get used to that.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Mother-in-law... not bad, not at all."

rows.jp: 「なんじゃそら」
rows.en: “What the hell does that mean?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Whassatmean."

rows.jp: 「太一」
rows.en: “Taichi.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Taichi."

rows.jp: 声はずいぶん後方から聞こえた。
rows.en: Her voice came from far behind me.

ghs.en: The voice I heard from far in the rear.

rows.en: “Hm?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "?"

rows.jp: ありえない距離だった。
rows.en: The distance was impossible.

ghs.en: An impossible distance,

rows.jp: 三秒前まで併走していた七香だ。
rows.en: Nanaka had been beside me three seconds ago.

ghs.en: as Nanaka was traveling right beside but three seconds ago.

rows.jp: 二十メートル。一瞬で移動できる距離じゃない。
rows.en: Twenty meters. No one could cross that distance in an instant.

ghs.en: Twenty meters. That is not a distance that can be traversed in an instant.
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: 「これが一番効果的みたいだからさ」
rows.en: “This seems to work best.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Because this seems to be have the most success..."

rows.jp: 「ちょ、キミ……」
rows.en: “Wait, you...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Wai-, you..."

rows.jp: やっぱり。
rows.en: Just as I’d thought.

ghs.en: I knew it.

rows.jp: 人じゃない。
rows.en: She wasn’t human.

ghs.en: Not a person.

rows.jp: 「……祠、知ってるね？」
rows.en: “...You know about the shrine, don’t you?”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "...the hokora, you know 'bout it right?"

rows.jp: 「祠って」
rows.en: “The shrine?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "What hokora?"

rows.jp: 『それと祠の情報で、だいたい把握できた』
rows.en: “Between that and the information about the shrine, I understand the situation more or less.”

ghs.en: Youko: 『With that and the information at the hokora I was able to understand the outline.』

rows.jp: 関係がある。
rows.en: They were connected.

ghs.en: It is connected.

rows.jp: 「知りたいのなら、あっち！」
rows.en: “If you want to know, that way!”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "If you want to know, 's there!"

rows.jp: 白い指先が俺をびっと指す。
rows.en: One white finger stabbed toward me.

ghs.en: A white fingertip shot out, pointed at me.

rows.jp: いや、俺の背後だ。
rows.en: No. Behind me.

ghs.en: No, at something behind me.

rows.jp: 学校。
rows.en: The school.

ghs.en: The school.

rows.jp: いや……山か。
rows.en: No... the mountain?

ghs.en: No... the mountain?

rows.jp: 合宿に行くときに使った山道がある。
rows.en: There was a mountain trail we’d used on the way to camp.

ghs.en: The mountain path that we used when going to the training camp is there.

rows.jp: ほとんど獣道だが、山頂に出るにははやい。
rows.en: It was scarcely more than an animal track, but it offered a quick route to the summit.

ghs.en: It's almost an animal trail, but it reaches the summit fast.

rows.jp: その先には。
rows.en: And beyond it—

ghs.en: And right before that,

rows.jp: 祠がある。
rows.en: stood a shrine.

ghs.en: there is a hokora.

rows.jp: 何が祀られていたのか、わからない。
rows.en: I didn’t know what had been worshiped there.

ghs.en: What is enshrined there I don't know.

rows.jp: 古く、朽ちた、小さな祠だ。
rows.en: It was an ancient, rotting little shrine.

ghs.en: It's an ancient, forgotten, tiny little hokora.

rows.jp: かつて、まつろわぬ神を奉じていたかもしれないその場所に。
rows.en: Perhaps it had once been dedicated to a god that refused to submit.

ghs.en: Once, it might have been that the place was dedicated to some rogue god.

rows.jp: 今は近寄る者もない。
rows.en: No one went near it anymore.

ghs.en: Now, nobody approaches it.

rows.jp: そこに何があるんだろう。
rows.en: What could be there?

ghs.en: There could be anything there.

rows.jp: 些細な疑問を返すべく、七香に視線を戻す。
rows.en: I turned back to Nanaka with that minor question in my eyes.

ghs.en: With the intent of tossing this trifling doubt her way, my sight returns to Nanaka.

rows.jp: 彼女はいなくなっていた。
rows.en: She was gone.

ghs.en: She was nowhere to be seen.

rows.jp: 自転車とともに。
rows.en: Bicycle and all.

ghs.en: And neither was her bike.
Taichi: "......"

rows.jp: 蝉も鳴いてない、静かな新学期だった。
rows.en: The cicadas were silent. It was a quiet start to the new term.

ghs.en: It was a quiet new school term, when even the cicadas didn't cry.
